title: Revision media comparison
responsibility: Aligns recorded screenshots and audio between selected revisions.

inputs.name: HarnessCompareMedia.base
inputs.description: Required base revision or undefined; undefined displays no-base guidance.

inputs.name: HarnessCompareMedia.head
inputs.description: Required head revision. Each side prefers a selected record, then a valid passed record, then its first record.

inputs.name: HarnessCompareMedia.mediaBase
inputs.description: Required media prefix forwarded to the gallery.

outputs.name: HarnessCompareMedia
outputs.description: Scenario/state/viewport controls and optional record selectors when a side has multiple records. Defaults to first available scenario and all states/viewports. Missing records and no recorded media are explicit; aligned-state text and gallery come from the comparison helper.
